rationale: The stock is at 95.9% of its intraday range after a massive move from $19.07 to $23.42, sitting just 0.77% below the session high with extremely compressed 1-minute candles showing stalling volume and minimal price movement — classic exhaustion near the top. While momentum is bullish (price above VWAP and 9-EMA), entering long this close to the high with a wide spread (34.4 bps) and a stock that has already run ~23% off its low offers poor risk/reward; a short near the high is tempting but the 6.98x relative volume and strong upward trend make a fade dangerous without a clear reversal signal.
